body:
## 🔏 Outcome

Preserve actual session-revocation socket-closure evidence across main-frame navigation in the existing two-login Chromium collaboration journey. The new observer uses Chromium's supported CDP Network events, independently of Playwright's per-document WebSocket map. Navigation, sign-in UI and Playwright-level close events remain diagnostics; none can substitute for actual protocol closure plus server denial.

Application authorization, session storage, socket transport and navigation behavior are unchanged. This completes only SPN-149's bounded observation repair; it does not include SPN-120's historical fixture inventory or SPN-145's worker activation.

## ✅ Acceptance record

**Initial source validation passed:** [CI 43364365825, attempt 1](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/43364365825) completed all **33 jobs** successfully on `db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb`; all seven protected checks and every selected worker passed. [Storybook 43364365751, attempt 1](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/43364365751) also passed its build, five viewport/theme reviews and interaction aggregate. Preview/deployment jobs were not applicable to this PR.

The [maintained acceptance record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/evidence/spn-149-acceptance-20261113/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-149/acceptance/README.md) and [machine-readable ledger](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/evidence/spn-149-acceptance-20261113/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-149/acceptance/acceptance.json) are authoritative for the latest source, reviews, every validation attempt, final merge and branch disposition. The initial immutable receipt is pinned at `0338f8c41ac45d8d34765cd9aa46c81a7fc22454`. The source/review tables below preserve the initial candidate; any necessary later base update must have its own exact qualifying reviews and acceptance recorded in the ledger.

| Required check | Successful initial job/check ID |
| --- | ---: |
| Backlog | 131685834150 |
| Pull request | 131685158763 |
| Lint | 131685834166 |
| Typecheck | 131685834289 |
| Unit tests | 131693806635 |
| Lib tests | 131690436695 |
| Playwright smoke | 131701094769 |

The exact coverage plan selected all 15 suite/flag entries. All 29 selected execution workers, three aggregates and the classifier are accounted for. Plan SHA-256: `e26b485c286be51036d5d213da96fea7fe251aa4600bdd76612964edbf90d15d`. Source: `db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb`; base: `04baabd6a68abe7c0b225f8699681532e2205b60`; tested merge: `9ee8ac68165f25e097c93f84bb2b20f00fcaf09e`. Its tree exactly matches the reviewed candidate.

### Native first-attempt sample

| Existing owner | Job | Actual attempts | Duration | Observed ordering |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | --- |
| Development 1/2 | 131685834643 | Retry 0 passed; no retries | 10,861 ms | Protocol close 164 ms after revocation was recorded; navigation 34 ms later |
| Production 1/2 | 131685834559 | Retry 0 passed; no retries | 4,845 ms | Protocol close 20 ms after revocation was recorded; navigation 27 ms later |

These are observer-delivery intervals; the original five-second closure bound was unchanged. Both page-level and protocol closes were observed in each sample. Both exact diagnostic attachments report one established target, one closed target, zero open sockets, completed full contract, no primary failure, no cleanup failure, and no overflow, observer loss or reopened connection. Denial, editor removal, surviving connection, forwarded queued edit, saved/reloaded native value and unchanged later frame counts all passed. Exact diagnostic bytes and hashes are preserved in the ledger files; raw browser archives remain supplementary and expire 2026-11-20.

**Diagnostic conclusion:** the pinned dependency's conditional map-clearing observation gap is demonstrated by the controlled probe. Navigation overtaking close was **not reproduced in the fixed two-sample native investigation**. The historical first-attempt ordering and historical cause remain unknown. Neither later acceptance nor this bounded conclusion reclassifies the original failed run.

The 19 focused negative controls also passed individually in hosted unit job `131685834288`; their exact content-free result lines are retained.

## 🔎 Evidence and limits

The original production attempt on source `f4b5c3f0740c46b00bd7d2d1fefb232edd7308a5` failed its original five-second closure poll in [run 42329786250](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/actions/runs/42329786250), job `128273632504`. Retry 0 lasted 7,537 ms; retry 1 passed in 6,759 ms. The worker still failed under `failOnFlakyTests`. Its sign-in DOM does not prove server revocation or socket closure, and the later assertions were never reached.

**The original first-attempt socket/session/navigation timeline is unavailable.** There was no first-attempt trace; the retained trace belongs to retry 1. Navigation overtaking the observer remains an unproven historical explanation, not an observed product security defect.

The original artifact `13557930894` (36,909,853 bytes; SHA-256 `8e1582f1d03595d272d95e2686680e474e63bc302590fd366998131f278d6366`) had seven-day retention, expiring 2026-11-14 02:54:57 UTC. The [reviewed content-free extracts and member hashes](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-149/original-13557930894-metadata.json) preserve essential evidence without publishing raw fixture credentials, socket payloads or the retry trace.

### Declared experiment

Before execution, local commit `d98f7d6b22459b4a9aa7306ab054c8e09e02e5d0` declared one falsifiable hypothesis: clearing Playwright's page socket map before its later protocol-close callback can lose page-level closure evidence, while an independent Chromium request-ID observer can retain it.

One browser-free dispatch probe exercised the actual pinned Playwright 1.64.1 frame manager once for each of two fixed orderings. Close-before-clear produced one page close; clear-before-close produced zero, with one established socket in each. This demonstrates the conditional observation boundary, not the missing historical ordering. The [probe, exact source/runtime identities, result and bounds](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb/docs/implementation/SPN-149.md#-observed-boundary-and-repair) are retained.

The native first-attempt diagnostic sample is fixed at the existing development and production Chromium two-login cases, retry 0 once each on the first reviewed hosted candidate. Configured retries remain separate evidence and cannot turn a flaky worker into acceptance. No sample-until-green expansion is authorized.

## 🧪 Test plan and evidence

| Regression contract | Owner and status |
| --- | --- |
| Navigation/close ordering, successful handshake, closure of every target, retained frame observation | 19 focused browser-free controls exercise the actual observer |
| Live socket despite 401; closed socket despite HTTP 200; unrelated close; reopened connection; observer loss/overflow | Negative controls reject each invalid acceptance |
| Listener ownership and bounded cleanup, including rejected setup with stalled detach | Controlled events and exact-bound mocked timers; no sleeps |
| Real socket termination, 401 denial, removed editor, surviving-login continuity and successful forwarded queued edit | Existing `e2e/collaboration.spec.ts` development/production Chromium journey; both initial retry-0 owners passed |
| No later matching socket frames and exact saved/reloaded native cell value | The same journey; no new browser matrix |
| Authority, transport, navigation, shared fixtures and harness routing | Existing CI routing retained; focused controls prove every selected missing/failed/skipped/cancelled worker fails closed |

The unchanged journey keeps its 60-second test timeout, five-second close poll, save/readiness deadlines, existing retries and `failOnFlakyTests`. Every attempt attaches bounded content-free event kinds, times, counts, source/runtime identity and cleanup disposition. No URL, credential, socket request ID, frame payload or authored cell value enters the new diagnostic attachment. Owned writes, observer, context and database cleanup each retain the existing five-second phase bound; failures cannot mask the primary assertion.

Pinned Node **26.13.0** was used with the shared serial runner and continuous process-tree/system-memory watchdog. Maximum local workload budget: 2 GiB RSS and eight minutes; no resource abort occurred. The repaired source passed **19/19 controls**, strict TypeScript, dependency boundaries, lint, formatting and the complete PR/backlog checker. [Every local attempt and exact source hashes](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-149/local-validation.json) are retained, including the original lint failure and its repair.

Local pinned Chromium installation failed because the official installer returned invalid/empty ZIPs on its five built-in attempts. No local browser case ran; this is an unavailable check, not a pass. Hosted owners remain required.

## 🔁 Independent review loop

Both reviewers are nonimplementing and read-only. They inspect the full rubric and run the focused controls locally; hosted status contributes no deduction.

| Candidate | Reviewer A | Reviewer B | Disposition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `8ee824a9787c630f7c9b02263461280611f68d59` | 100/100 | 97/100 | No validation branch/PR published. Both local findings repaired before publication. |
| `db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb` | 100/100 | 100/100 | Both findings resolved; no actionable findings or unresolved blockers. Each reviewer independently passed all 19 controls. |

[Full first-round reports and finding dispositions](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-149/review-iteration-1.json) are maintained. Review B demonstrated setup stuck beyond 5,106 ms after rejected `Network.enable` plus never-settling detach (2 points), and missing copied-source attribution (1 point). Setup cleanup now uses the existing five-second bound, with an exact 4,999/5,000 ms regression. The original upstream Apache header, extraction note and third-party notice are preserved.

Both pre-publication reviewers scored the rubric **35/35 scope, 25/25 correctness/access, 20/20 regression/local verification, 10/10 CI/operations, 10/10 maintainability/process = 100/100** on the exact shared head `db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb`. Every remaining step to 100: none. Reviewer A (`/root/review_a`) ran 19 controls in 582 ms, peak 230,868 KiB; reviewer B (`/root/review_b`) ran them in 557 ms, peak 233,840 KiB. Both used Node 26.13.0, the serial runner and watchdog; zero failures/skips/cancellations/resource aborts. They rechecked all 14 source hashes, local repair logs, unchanged acceptance and historical limitations. Hosted acceptance is assessed separately from review grades.

## 📦 Initial candidate and bookkeeping

- Reviewed source/head: `db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb`.
- Complete tree: `42cd4dfe89d0281ff5b11aa984053bd0493e22bb`.
- Base: `04baabd6a68abe7c0b225f8699681532e2205b60`.
- Diff: **18 files, 1,649 additions + 120 deletions = 1,769 changed lines**, below the configured soft limit.
- Ticket Rules preserved in the [maintained implementation record](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/db24230dd4df539e2055471f55e50a402596c1fb/docs/implementation/SPN-149.md); only SPN-149 removed.
- Completion appended to `grooming.completed_since`; grooming date and next-ticket counter unchanged. No dependent ticket listed SPN-149.
- Backlog index regenerated with `npm run backlog:index`, never edited by hand: 22 open tickets.
- Operator receives durable first-attempt diagnostics; Owner/Collaborator retain denial, real closure, continuity and persistence; Link guest authority remains unchanged.
- No product UI changes; visual approval is not applicable.

## 🔐 Publication, merge and archive

Both qualifying reviews preceded initial validation publication. Initial hosted acceptance has now passed independently of those grades.

CI selection is intentionally unchanged: the new harness path and diagnostic JSON select the existing full plan. Require all seven current-head gates—**Backlog, Pull request, Lint, Typecheck, Unit tests, Lib tests, Playwright smoke**—and every selected worker, including both fixed native revocation attempts, before readiness or merge. Storybook applicability also remains intact. Current repository ruleset `25319790` requires those seven checks, an up-to-date branch, resolved review threads and squash-only merging; it has no bypass actors.

Existing SPN-148 and SPN-087 runs were checked before publication and are left intact. No blind workflow rerun, cancelled selected worker, later green run or inconclusive diagnosis can waive a failed current-head acceptance.

Publishing this consolidated description triggers another full core CI run under the repository's current `pull_request: edited` rule. That run is required acceptance on the exact reviewed source; it is not an assertion retry or an expansion of the fixed diagnostic sample. Its complete identity, all results and any subsequent necessary source/base changes will be retained in the maintained ledger, avoiding further metadata-validation cycles. Readiness and guarded squash merge require that latest current-head acceptance to pass.

After acceptance, recheck current main and exact source/review identities, mark ready, squash-merge with the expected-head guard, verify the landed tree and PR state, and record the squash identity and cleanup in the ledger.

The receipt branch `evidence/spn-149-acceptance-20261113` keeps necessary evidence reachable. The current GitHub integration has no tag-creation or guarded remote-ref-deletion operation, and shell GitHub push/browser sign-in are unavailable. Its exact retained head and outstanding archival/deletion prerequisite will be recorded as **incomplete cleanup**, not claimed as deleted. The implementation branch is configured for automatic deletion after merge; local preparation refs will be checked and deleted with head guards after preserving their unique evidence. No acceptance gate is waived by this archival limitation.
